title: The CANMAT and ISBD Guidelines for the Treatment of Bipolar Disorder: Summary and a 2023 Update of Evidence
organization: Canadian Network for Mood and Anxiety Treatments and International Society for Bipolar Disorders
versionLabel: Summary of the 2018 guideline with evidence update through 2023
citation: Keramatian K, Chithra NK, Yatham LN. The CANMAT and ISBD Guidelines for the Treatment of Bipolar Disorder: Summary and a 2023 Update of Evidence. Focus (Am Psychiatr Publ). 2023;21(4):344-353. doi:10.1176/appi.focus.20230009.
populations: People with bipolar disorder across the lifespan

sourceRelations.note: This article summarizes the 2018 CANMAT/ISBD guideline and adds evidence available through 2023; it is not recorded as a replacement full guideline.
